Minuteman Security & Life Safety is hiring a Solutions Developer I to help business teams solve problems and streamline operations with technology. The role builds and maintains AI-assisted automations, system integrations, internal tools, dashboards, and reports, and supports their adoption and reliability.
Cyber Security
Professional Services
Physical Security
Security
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Use AI-assisted development tools, such as Cursor and Claude, to design, build, and test tools, automations, integrations, and dashboards faster
Review and test AI-generated code to make sure it is secure, reliable, and meets team standards
Automate business processes across departments using APIs, scripting, and other appropriate tools
Develop and support integrations between systems such as Paylocity, ConnectWise PSA, ConnectWise CPQ, and Microsoft 365, building in data mapping, error handling, and retry logic so integrations are reliable
Build, test, and enhance internal tools and small applications that help departments work more efficiently
Follow team standards for design, naming, environments, security, and connections
Build and maintain dashboards and reports in reporting tools as needed
Help validate data quality and accuracy with business users
Work with the Business Technology Partners and departments to understand business problems and turn them into technology solutions
Refine requirements and incorporate user feedback throughout development
Monitor automations, integrations, and tools, including the time-entry and Paylocity webhook integrations, and troubleshoot and resolve failures promptly
Respond to issues escalated by the Application Support Specialist and the Business Technology Partners
Document solutions, including purpose, dependencies, owners, and support procedures
Track work and changes in Azure DevOps and follow testing and release procedures
Promote the use of technology across the company by sharing solutions, helping users adopt new tools, and identifying new opportunities to streamline operations
Perform other job-related duties as assigned
Focus on excellence in everything you do and each interaction you have with all clients
Absorb the training. Make yourself an expert on our portfolio of solutions
Always understand that you are the face of the company to our customers
Every project and service call are different so you must enjoy variety in your workday
Work closely with Minuteman’s sales, management, and operations teams to best serve our customers
Turn challenges into opportunities
Play To Win

Required
Hands-on experience with, or a strong interest in, AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude, or similar
Hands-on experience with a scripting or programming language such as Python, PowerShell, or JavaScript
Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and system integrations
Experience building dashboards and reports with modern reporting tools
Working knowledge of SQL and data modeling
Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Teams, SharePoint, and Azure
Strong troubleshooting skills with attention to detail
Excellent verbal and written communication skills for conveying technical concepts to non-technical audiences
Experience in software development, automation, or related fields
Preferred
Experience with Paylocity, ConnectWise PSA, or ConnectWise CPQ is a plus
Familiarity with Azure DevOps, source control, or similar tools is a plus
Benefits
This position may also be eligible for a variable bonus or commission in addition to base salary.
This position may also be eligible for health coverage.
This position may also be eligible for paid holidays.
